gen.title: How often and how presidential elections happen

cards.stem: How often is a presidential election held in the United States?
cards.quote: An election for president of the United States happens every four years on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November.
cards.hint: Recall the timing stated for the election

cards.stem: How long does the process of electing a president take?
cards.quote: The process of electing a president takes almost two years.
cards.hint: Think about the total length described at the start

cards.stem: What happens in December as part of the presidential cycle?
options: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College
cards.quote: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College.
cards.hint: Focus on what happens in December

cards.stem: What do parties do at their conventions to select a candidate?
options: Parties hold nominating conventions to choose their presidential candidates
States and parties hold presidential primaries and caucuses
Candidates register with the Federal Election Commission to run for president
cards.quote: Parties hold nominating conventions to choose their presidential candidates.
cards.hint: Consider the purpose of the party gatherings
